info.title: SmartRecruiters Jobs Scraper — New Postings Since Any Date
info.description:
Scrape open jobs from any SmartRecruiters careers site and return only postings released since a date or window (24h, 7d, 30d). Title, location, department, URL, description. Pay per result.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/smartrecruiters-jobs-scraper
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/smartrecruiters-jobs-scraper
Author: Public Records.
